idea-plugin.name: LDAP browser
idea-plugin.description:
LDAP browser adds an LDAP tool window to IntelliJ Platform IDEs, including IntelliJ IDEA, PhpStorm, and other JetBrains products.

The plugin can connect to LDAP and LDAPS servers, browse directory entries, inspect and edit entry attributes, and run ad hoc LDAP searches from inside the IDE.

Version 1.7 refreshes the plugin for 2026.1 IDE builds and improves Active Directory usage: background connection/search operations, subtree search with referral handling, group member browsing, DN reference navigation from editor tabs, reveal-in-tree support, multi-row attribute copying, and safer display of binary Active Directory attributes.

Supported authentication methods are anonymous bind and simple authentication. The plugin uses Apache Directory LDAP API version @apacheDirectoryApiVersion@.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.7
    • Updated compatibility for JetBrains 2026.1 IDEs.
    • Moved LDAP connect, refresh, browse, and search operations off the UI thread to reduce IDE freezes.
    • Added an LDAP Search dialog with base DN, filter, scope, and result limit controls.
    • Added referral-aware LDAP search and browse support, including Active Directory referral URLs.
    • Improved Active Directory browsing with bounded subtree fallback when one-level browse returns no direct children.
    • Added synthetic group member browsing for member and uniqueMember DN attributes.
    • Added editor navigation for DN reference attributes such as memberOf, member, manager, managedBy, and distinguishedName.
    • Added Reveal in LDAP Tree for editor tabs without recursively expanding the directory tree.
    • Improved attribute table selection and copying for multi-valued attributes.
    • Displayed binary attributes safely: objectSid and msExchMasterAccountSid as SIDs, GUID attributes as UUIDs, and opaque binary values as hex.
    • Expanded binary formatting for Active Directory and DNS attributes including mS-DS-ConsistencyGuid, msDFSR GUID fields, msExchMailboxGuid, msExchMailboxSecurityDescriptor, logonHours, pKTGuid, pKT, dNSProperty, and dnsRecord.
    • Fixed port formatting, tree expansion, null child nodes, and editor compatibility exceptions on recent IntelliJ Platform builds.
    • Added clearer Connect and Close Connection toolbar states.
  • 1.6
    • Apache Directory API version upgrade to 2.0.0.AM4
    • SSL support
    • Default connection timeout has been set to 3 seconds
    • Minor UI fixes
  • 1.5
    • Apache Directory API version upgrade to 2.0.0.AM3
    • Dialogs initial size fix
    • Added disconnect toolbar button and handling states according to selected item
    • Auto expand server node after connected
  • 1.4
    • Fixed reading/writing attributes
    • Apache Directory API version upgrade to 1.0.2
  • 1.3
    • Fixed NPE when connecting to some type of LDAP servers
  • 1.2
    • Schema ckeck removed, schema is now loaded and processed through the SchemaManager provided by the LDAP API
    • "New entry" dialog object class list now displays the schema name too + fixed some color issues
  • 1.1
    • Schema dn check during connection
    • New connection dialog
  • First relese
